corrections.claim: Before you start, where the pane lives
corrections.before: This is its own Organization destination.
corrections.after: It has its own entry in the Organization group. The word destination now means a Saved key destination in this guide, so the old wording was ambiguous.
corrections.source: apps/web/src/routes/settings.tsx ORGANIZATION_GROUP entry ai-analysis; CONTEXT.md Saved key

corrections.claim: Before you start, when a key is not needed
corrections.before: unless a Saved key is already on file for that provider
corrections.after: unless a Saved key is already on file for that destination. A Saved key is reused only for the same preset, protocol and normalized base URL.
Select the Provider card title to open it. It starts closed on every visit. Its header shows Connected, Turned off or Not connected.
corrections.source: apps/web/src/routes/settings-ai-analysis.tsx SettingsCard collapsible defaultOpen={false}, ConnectionChip; apps/web/src/components/settings-card.tsx useState(defaultOpen)

corrections.before: No statement about text typed into Model.
corrections.after: Typing only narrows the list. Leaving the box without choosing a listed model restores the model chosen before. Choose from list turns the list back on after manual entry.
corrections.source: apps/web/src/components/ai-model-selector.tsx onChange sets only the query, onBlur setEditing(null), commit only on option or Enter; settings.aiAnalysis.models.useList

corrections.before: The list can include models that do not support Contract analysis.
corrections.after: OpenLaw drops Gemini models without generateContent, OpenRouter models without text input and output, and inactive, speech and safety models from Groq. The list can still include unsuitable models.

corrections.before: After saving a connector, choose ... Short text Fields use that summary when the Organization default is Full clause text.
corrections.after: Answer style is the Organization default for Contract Text and Long text Fields only; the seven built-in values have no text type. The radios are disabled until a connector is saved and the card shows 'Connect an AI provider to choose an answer style.' A Field can override it. Conversion drafts use the same style for their text Fields. A new style applies to the next run; written values keep their form.
corrections.source: apps/api/src/lib/ai/http.ts extractionPrompt (style only for text and long_text, text + full_clause falls back to sentence); packages/shared/src/analysis.ts CORE_ANALYSIS_TARGETS types; apps/web/src/components/ai-answer-style-card.tsx; apps/api/src/lib/conversion-draft.ts answerStyle; CTR-008 addendum 2026-09-20

corrections.claim: Per-Field answer style in the Field editor
corrections.before: Step 2 said only to enter the AI prompt and save.
corrections.after: For a Text or Long text Field, Answer style appears below the prompt. Keep Organisation default (it shows the current default in parentheses) or choose a style. Full clause text cannot be chosen for a Text Field.

corrections.claim: Attaching the Field to the Contract Type
corrections.before: Attach the active Field to the Contract Type used by your test Contract. Only ... Fields attached to that Contract Type ...
corrections.after: Open the Type's Form tab, select Attach Field and choose the Field so the Form has a Row for it. Only Fields with a Row on that Type's Form and an AI prompt are included.
corrections.source: messages/en-US.json typeForm.attach-field; CONTEXT.md Row (avoid 'attachment'); apps/api/src/lib/analysis-targets.ts contractTypeFields join

corrections.claim: Data sent in an Analysis run
corrections.before: It sends extracted text from that target, plus the requested Field identifiers and their prompts.
corrections.after: Adds that the run also asks for Key dates, and that this request carries the Contract's existing Key dates, effective and expiry dates, notice deadline and date values saved in its Fields as comparison data. This existed at 3fa407e3 too; the DOC-029 review did not record it.

corrections.claim: A value that still fails validation
corrections.before: Unsupported answers stay empty. (A malformed reply after the corrective attempt was implied to fail the batch.)
corrections.after: If a value still has the wrong type after the corrective attempt, the run writes nothing for that value and saves the other values.
corrections.source: apps/api/src/lib/ai/structured-extraction.ts validateReply(allowInvalidValues on attempt 1); 49e8449a (#958); CTR-008 addendum 'One bad answer no longer sinks the run'

corrections.before: The Disable, rotate, or remove section named only Saved keys; the switch reset was in the last section only.
corrections.after: Removal also turns off the three Request conversion switches and sets Answer style back to 1-2 sentence summary.
corrections.source: apps/api/src/modules/ai-connector/routes.ts DELETE /ai-connector deletes the row; readConnector(undefined) answers answerStyle 'sentence' and all switches false

corrections.claim: What the reader checks after a run
corrections.before: Check the run's Version, model, evidence, and saved values.
corrections.after: Check the run's Version, evidence, and saved values. The Contract record does not name the model; the run uses the Model saved on the connector when it starts.

Structured output per protocol with fallback on a named unsupported field; batches of at most 12 targets, two at a time, one corrective attempt, five-minute batch window, at most fifteen minutes; json_validate_failed gets the corrective attempt; refusals and configuration errors do not

A Legal Team Member can run Analysis but not configure it

limitations: Source inspection only. No lab, browser or provider call was run by this seat.

Provider-account facts in the provider table (Anthropic workspace-scoped keys, OpenAI application keys, Groq plan limits and its model list, Groq's 16,384-token limit for qwen/qwen3.8-27b) are external. The code cannot confirm them. They were kept as written by the feature PRs.

The registry negative checks for an invalid key, an invalid model and a provider refusal need a live provider. The guide names the visible results: the test shows 'The connection test failed.' followed by the provider message, and Load models shows the refusal (for example 'The provider refused model discovery with HTTP 404.'). The walkthrough agent must produce these live.
The app does not show a per-value Invalid outcome on the Contract any more. A value that fails validation after repair writes nothing, so the walkthrough can observe it only as an unchanged value.
The Answer style card stays usable while Use AI analysis is off; only a saved connector is required. No decision record says otherwise, so this is not recorded as a defect.
